```{r load libraries}
library(CellChat)
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
```

#Read the data
```{r read the integrated scRNA data}
seu <- readRDS("/path_to_folder/HarmonyIntegrated_annotated_data_final.rds")

#subset the seu object based on the groups- nonsmoker, smoker and copd
seu.nonsmoker <- subset(seu, subset = orig.ident == "nonsmoker")
seu.smoker <- subset(seu, subset = orig.ident == "smoker")
seu.copd <- subset(seu, subset = orig.ident == "COPD")
```

```{r COPD}
# normalized RNA expression data
data.input1 <- GetAssayData(seu.copd, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")

# metadata including cell types
meta <- seu.copd@meta.data

# assign the cell type information to a separate column
meta$celltype <- meta$predicted.ann_finest_level

# Use normalized RNA data (Seurat v5+)
data.input1 <- GetAssayData(seu.copd, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")

cellchat <- createCellChat(
  object = data.input1,
  meta = meta,
  group.by = "celltype"
)
```

``` {r cell chat}

# set a ligand receptor db for human
cellchat@DB <- CellChatDB.human  

cellchat <- subsetData(cellchat)                 # subset expressed genes
cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedGenes(cellchat)
cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedInteractions(cellchat)

#compute cell-cell communication
cellchat <- computeCommunProb(cellchat)
cellchat <- filterCommunication(cellchat, min.cells = 10)  # remove rare interactions
cellchat <- computeCommunProbPathway(cellchat)
cellchat <- aggregateNet(cellchat)

# Overall number of interactions
netVisual_circle(cellchat@net$count, vertex.weight = as.numeric(table(cellchat@idents)), weight.scale = TRUE, label.edge = FALSE)

# Interaction strength
netVisual_circle(cellchat@net$weight, vertex.weight = as.numeric(table(cellchat@idents)), weight.scale = TRUE)
```

```{r b cell subset}
#only choose B cells as senders and recievers

# See all interactions
head(cellchat@net$weight)  # or subsetCommunication(cellchat)

# Filter communication involving B cells
bcell_interactions <- subsetCommunication(
  cellchat,
  sources.use = "B cells",   # use exact label from step 1
  targets.use = NULL
)

#check what cell types are there in interaction
unique(c(bcell_interactions$source, bcell_interactions$target))

# Suppose your Seurat cell type column is "predicted.ann_finest_level"
cells_to_keep <- colnames(seu.copd)[
  seu.copd@meta.data$predicted.ann_finest_level %in% unique(c(bcell_interactions$source, bcell_interactions$target))
]

length(cells_to_keep)  # should now be >0

data_subset <- data.input1[, cells_to_keep, drop = FALSE]
meta_subset <- seu.copd@meta.data[cells_to_keep, , drop = FALSE]

dim(data_subset)  # genes x cells

#make a B cell specific cellchat object
cellchat_b <- createCellChat(
  object = data_subset,
  meta = meta_subset,
  group.by = "predicted.ann_finest_level"  # your cell type column
)

cellchat_b@DB <- CellChatDB.human  

# Subset expressed genes and interactions
cellchat_b <- subsetData(cellchat_b)

# Identify over-expressed genes and interactions
cellchat_b <- identifyOverExpressedGenes(cellchat_b)
cellchat_b <- identifyOverExpressedInteractions(cellchat_b)

# Compute probabilities of communication
cellchat_b <- computeCommunProb(cellchat_b)

# Optional: filter out rare interactions
cellchat_b <- filterCommunication(cellchat_b, min.cells = 10)

# Compute signaling pathway-level communication
cellchat_b <- computeCommunProbPathway(cellchat_b)

# Aggregate the network
cellchat_b <- aggregateNet(cellchat_b)

#circle plot with number of interactions

netVisual_circle(
  cellchat_b@net$count,
  vertex.weight = as.numeric(table(cellchat_b@idents)),  # size proportional to number of cells
  weight.scale = TRUE,
  label.edge = FALSE
)

#circle plot with strength of interactions
netVisual_circle(
  cellchat_b@net$weight,
  vertex.weight = as.numeric(table(cellchat_b@idents)),
  weight.scale = TRUE
)

bcell_interactions <- subsetCommunication(cellchat_b)

write.csv(
  bcell_interactions, 
  "/path_to_folder/Bcell_interactions_copd.csv", 
  row.names = FALSE
)
 
```


```{r save rds}
saveRDS(cellchat, file = "/path_to_folder/cellchat_all_copd.rds")
saveRDS(cellchat_b, file = "/path_to_folder/cellchat_bcell_copd.rds")

```


```{r Plot final graphs}
#subset to specific cell types

cells.use <- c("B cells", "AT2", "Transitional Club-AT2", "CD4 T cells", "CD8 T cells")

#extract the interactions
bcell_subset <- subsetCommunication(
  cellchat_b,
  sources.use = cells.use,
  targets.use = cells.use
)

#Plot a circle plot
netVisual_circle(
  cellchat_b@net$count[cells.use, cells.use],
  vertex.weight = as.numeric(table(cellchat_b@idents)[cells.use]),
  weight.scale = TRUE,
  label.edge = FALSE
)


par(mar = c(2,2,2,2))
par(family = "Times New Roman")

#add interaction strength
plot1<- netVisual_circle(
  cellchat_b@net$weight[cells.use, cells.use],
  vertex.weight = as.numeric(table(cellchat_b@idents)[cells.use]),
  weight.scale = TRUE,
  arrow.size = 0.6,
  arrow.width = 1,
  # Label formatting
  vertex.label.cex = 1.4,
  label.edge = FALSE,
)

plot1

# Define your cell type of interest
cell_type <- "B cells"
targets <- c("AT2", "Transitional Club-AT2", "B cells", "CD4 T cells", "Multiciliated (non-nasal)")

# Subset interactions where B cells are either source or target
bcell_interactions <- subsetCommunication(
  cellchat_b,
  sources.use = cell_type, 
  targets.use = targets 
)

#sort by strength
bcell_interactions <- bcell_interactions[order(-bcell_interactions$prob), ]
head(bcell_interactions, 5)  

write.csv(
  bcell_interactions,
  "/path_to_folder/Bcell_sender_copd.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)



```
